question: Should OpenClaw adopt `local`, `container`, `reverse-proxy`, and `node-mode` as its first named, release-tested Gateway hosting-profile catalog once the readiness contract is accepted?
rationale: The branch intentionally introduces new configuration and support-contract surface; source review can confirm the proposal is bounded, but cannot determine which deployment postures OpenClaw should promise to support.

options.title: Defer catalog acceptance until RFC 0018
options.body: Keep this RFC open while the readiness contract is decided, then review the four-profile catalog against the accepted activation and compatibility model.

options.title: Adopt the four-profile catalog
options.body: Accept the RFC as the initial support contract and require the linked core implementation to provide exact-head packaged conformance proof before rollout.

options.title: Narrow the initial catalog
options.body: Accept only the postures with clear owner support now and retain the remaining profiles as later RFC work.

recommendation.title: Defer catalog acceptance until RFC 0018
recommendation.body: Keep this RFC open while the readiness contract is decided, then review the four-profile catalog against the accepted activation and compatibility model.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this author to both the dependent readiness proposal and this profile catalog; additional Gateway and security-owner approval is still needed.
